name: Promptcart
author: José PEREZ

sections.description:
More and more shoppers ask an AI assistant which product to buy, then click the link it gives. Do those buyers reach your store, and how much do they spend? Promptcart answers with real order figures.

Since version 8.5, WooCommerce records the source of every order (“order attribution”: source type, UTM source, referrer, landing page). ChatGPT adds utm_source=chatgpt.com to its links; Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude and others leave their domain as referrer. Promptcart reads this data, recognises the AI assistants and turns it into a revenue report.

  • Retroactive from the first minute. Your past orders already carry their source: the report covers the last 30 days, 90 days or 12 months as soon as the plugin is activated. A notice on the Plugins screen gives you the 12-month figure right away.
  • No tracking code added. Promptcart adds no script, no cookie and no request: it only reads what WooCommerce has already recorded. Nothing changes on your storefront or at checkout.
  • Four figures that matter: revenue from AI assistants (with the change versus the previous period), share of your store revenue, number of orders, average order compared with the whole store.
  • By assistant: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Le Chat (Mistral AI), DeepSeek, Meta AI, Grok, You.com, Phind.
  • Pages where AI assistants sent buyers: the landing pages that turned AI recommendations into sales, so you know which content AI assistants pick up.
  • Products bought by these buyers, month-by-month chart and the latest orders, linked to the order screen.
  • A counter on the menu when new orders from AI assistants have arrived since your last visit, like pending comments.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and with the legacy order storage.

What is counted, and what is not

  • Counted: paid orders (Processing and Completed by default, as defined by WooCommerce) in your store currency; order totals including tax and shipping, before refunds.
  • Not counted: AI apps that open links without sending a referrer (WooCommerce records them as Direct), and Google AI Overviews or AI Mode, which arrive as Google search and cannot be told apart from it. The figures are therefore a minimum, never an inflated estimate.
  • Orders placed before WooCommerce 8.5, or while a consent tool blocked the WooCommerce attribution script, have no source data. The report says how many orders of the period carry source data.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.5 or later, with order attribution turned on (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Features). It is on by default; Promptcart warns you if it is off.

External services

Promptcart does not connect to any external service. It sends no data outside your site and loads no file from another domain.

Privacy

Promptcart stores no personal data. It reads the order attribution fields recorded by WooCommerce and keeps only aggregated figures in a temporary cache (WordPress transients). Deleting the plugin removes its options and cache; WooCommerce order data is never modified.

ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Le Chat, DeepSeek, Meta AI, Grok, You.com and Phind are trademarks of their respective owners. Promptcart is not affiliated with or endorsed by them; the names are used only to identify the source of visits.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Promptcart (WooCommerce must be active).
  2. The notice on the Plugins screen shows the revenue from AI assistants over the last 12 months.
  3. Open WooCommerce > AI assistant sales for the full report. There is nothing to set up.
sections.faq:
Does Promptcart track my visitors?

No. It adds no code to your storefront and no cookie. It reads the order attribution data that WooCommerce already stores with each order.

Why are some sales from AI assistants missing?

Some AI apps open links without telling the browser where the visit comes from: WooCommerce then records a direct visit. Google AI Overviews and AI Mode send visitors as Google search. Promptcart only counts what can be proven from the order data.

Can I add another assistant?

Yes, with the promptcart_assistants filter: add_filter( 'promptcart_assistants', function ( $list ) { $list['example'] = array( 'Example AI', array( 'example-ai.com' ) ); return $list; } );

Who can see the report?

Users who can view WooCommerce reports (the view_woocommerce_reports capability: administrators and shop managers by default).

Does it slow down my site?

No. Nothing runs on the storefront. The report is calculated in the admin, kept in cache for 12 hours and refreshed when a new order arrives or an order status changes.
